                    ensureEngine();

                    Log.i(TAG,
                            "Piper engine ready in "
                                    + (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                    - start)
                                    + " ms");
                } catch (Throwable e) {
                    Log.e(TAG,
                            "Piper preload failed",
                            e);
                }
            }
        });
    }

    public synchronized void stop() {
        generation.incrementAndGet();

        Future<?> job = currentJob;
        currentJob = null;

        if (job != null) {
            job.cancel(true);
        }

        AudioTrack track = currentTrack;

        if (track != null) {
            try {
                track.pause();
                track.flush();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }

        busy = false;
    }

    public synchronized void speak(
            final String replyText,
            final String emotionKey,
            final Listener listener) {

        stop();

        final int myGeneration =
                generation.get();

        final String text =
                sanitize(replyText);

        if (text.isEmpty()) {
            postFinished(
                    myGeneration,
                    listener
            );
            return;
        }

        busy = true;

        currentJob =
                executor.submit(new Runnable() {
                    @Override
                    public void run() {

                        try {
                            long totalStart =
                                    SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                            Log.i(
                                    TAG,
                                    "TTS request started"
                            );

                            OfflineTts engine =
                                    ensureEngine();

                            if (myGeneration
                                    != generation.get()) {
                                return;
                            }

                            float speed =
                                    speedForEmotion(
                                            emotionKey);

                            long genStart =
                                    SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                            GeneratedAudio audio =
                                    engine.generate(
                                            text,
                                            SPEAKER_ID,
                                            speed
                                    );

                            long genMs =
                                    SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                            - genStart;

                            Log.i(
                                    TAG,
                                    "Piper generation took "
                                            + genMs
                                            + " ms for "
                                            + text.length()
                                            + " chars"
                            );

                            if (myGeneration
                                    != generation.get()) {
                                return;
                            }

                            play(
                                    audio,
                                    myGeneration,
                                    listener
                            );

                            Log.i(
                                    TAG,
                                    "Total TTS time: "
                                            + (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                            - totalStart)
                                            + " ms"
                            );

                        } catch (Throwable e) {

                            Log.e(
                                    TAG,
                                    "Piper TTS failed",
                                    e
                            );

                            postError(
                                    myGeneration,
                                    listener,
                                    "Local voice unavailable."
                            );

                        } finally {

                            if (myGeneration
                                    == generation.get()) {
                                busy = false;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });
    }

    public synchronized void release() {
        stop();

        executor.shutdownNow();

        OfflineTts engine = tts;
        tts = null;

        if (engine != null) {
            try {
                engine.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private OfflineTts ensureEngine()
            throws IOException {

        OfflineTts existing = tts;

        if (existing != null) {
            return existing;
        }

        synchronized (this) {

            if (tts != null) {
                return tts;
            }

            File dir =
                    new File(
                            context.getFilesDir(),
                            MODEL_DIR_NAME
                    );

            prepareModelFiles(dir);

            String model =
                    new File(
                            dir,
                            "en_US-amy-low.onnx"
                    ).getAbsolutePath();

            String tokens =
                    new File(
                            dir,
                            "tokens.txt"
                    ).getAbsolutePath();

            String dataDir =
                    new File(
                            dir,
                            "espeak-ng-data"
                    ).getAbsolutePath();

            OfflineTtsVitsModelConfig vits =
                    new OfflineTtsVitsModelConfig();

            vits.setModel(model);
            vits.setLexicon("");
            vits.setTokens(tokens);
            vits.setDataDir(dataDir);
            vits.setDictDir("");
            vits.setNoiseScale(0.667f);
            vits.setNoiseScaleW(0.8f);
            vits.setLengthScale(1.0f);

            OfflineTtsModelConfig modelConfig =
                    new OfflineTtsModelConfig();

            modelConfig.setVits(vits);
            modelConfig.setNumThreads(NUM_THREADS);
            modelConfig.setDebug(false);
            modelConfig.setProvider("cpu");

            OfflineTtsConfig config =
                    new OfflineTtsConfig();

            config.setModel(modelConfig);
            config.setRuleFsts("");
            config.setRuleFars("");
            config.setMaxNumSentences(1);
            config.setSilenceScale(0.2f);

            // Paths above point to normal filesystem files.
            tts = new OfflineTts(null, config);

            return tts;
        }
    }

    private void prepareModelFiles(File dir)
            throws IOException {

        File model =
                new File(
                        dir,
                        "en_US-amy-low.onnx"
                );

        File tokens =
                new File(
                        dir,
                        "tokens.txt"
                );

        File espeak =
                new File(
                        dir,
                        "espeak-ng-data"
                );

        if (model.isFile()
                && tokens.isFile()
                && espeak.isDirectory()) {
            return;
        }

        deleteRecursively(dir);

        if (!dir.mkdirs()
                && !dir.isDirectory()) {
            throw new IOException(
                    "Cannot create Piper model directory"
            );
        }

        copyAssetTree(
                context.getAssets(),
                ASSET_ROOT,
                dir
        );
    }

    private static void copyAssetTree(
            AssetManager assets,
            String assetPath,
            File out)
            throws IOException {

        String[] children =
                assets.list(assetPath);

        if (children != null
                && children.length > 0) {

            if (!out.exists()
                    && !out.mkdirs()) {
                throw new IOException(
                        "Cannot create directory: "
                                + out
                );
            }

            for (String child : children) {
                copyAssetTree(
                        assets,
                        assetPath + "/" + child,
                        new File(out, child)
                );
            }

            return;
        }

        File parent =
                out.getParentFile();

        if (parent != null
                && !parent.exists()
                && !parent.mkdirs()) {
            throw new IOException(
                    "Cannot create directory: "
                            + parent
            );
        }

        InputStream input =
                assets.open(
                        assetPath,
                        AssetManager.ACCESS_STREAMING
                );

        FileOutputStream output =
                new FileOutputStream(out);

        try {
            byte[] buffer =
                    new byte[64 * 1024];

            int count;

            while ((count =
                    input.read(buffer)) != -1) {

                output.write(
                        buffer,
                        0,
                        count
                );
            }

        } finally {

            try {
                input.close();
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }

            try {
                output.close();
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private void play(
            GeneratedAudio audio,
            int myGeneration,
            Listener listener)
            throws IOException {

        float[] samples =
                audio.getSamples();

        int sampleRate =
                audio.getSampleRate();

        if (samples == null
                || samples.length == 0
                || sampleRate <= 0) {

            throw new IOException(
                    "empty generated audio"
            );
        }

        short[] pcm =
                new short[samples.length];

        for (int i = 0;
             i < samples.length;
             i++) {

            float x = samples[i];

            if (x > 1.0f) {
                x = 1.0f;
            } else if (x < -1.0f) {
                x = -1.0f;
            }

            pcm[i] =
                    (short) Math.round(
                            x * 32767.0f
                    );
        }

        int channelMask =
                AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO;

        int minBuffer =
                AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                        sampleRate,
                        channelMask,
                        AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
                );

        if (minBuffer <= 0) {
            throw new IOException(
                    "audio output unavailable"
            );
        }

        int bufferSize =
                Math.max(
                        minBuffer * 2,
                        sampleRate * 2 / 5
                );

        AudioTrack track =
                new AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(
                                new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                        .setUsage(
                                                AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA
                                        )
                                        .setContentType(
                                                AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH
                                        )
                                        .build()
                        )
                        .setAudioFormat(
                                new AudioFormat.Builder()
                                        .setEncoding(
                                                AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
                                        )
                                        .setSampleRate(
                                                sampleRate
                                        )
                                        .setChannelMask(
                                                channelMask
                                        )
                                        .build()
                        )
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(
                                bufferSize
                        )
                        .setTransferMode(
                                AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM
                        )
                        .build();

        if (track.getState()
                != AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {

            track.release();

            throw new IOException(
                    "audio output not initialized"
            );
        }

        currentTrack = track;

        try {

            if (myGeneration
                    != generation.get()) {
                return;
            }

            track.play();

            postStarted(
                    myGeneration,
                    listener
            );

            int offset = 0;

            while (offset < pcm.length
                    && myGeneration
                    == generation.get()) {

                int count =
                        Math.min(
                                2048,
                                pcm.length - offset
                        );

                int written =
                        track.write(
                                pcm,
                                offset,
                                count
                        );

                if (written < 0) {
                    throw new IOException(
                            "AudioTrack.write failed: "
                                    + written
                    );
                }

                offset += written;
            }

            if (myGeneration
                    != generation.get()) {
                return;
            }

            long totalFrames =
                    pcm.length;

            long deadline =
                    System.currentTimeMillis()
                            + ((totalFrames
                            * 1000L)
                            / sampleRate)
                            + 2000L;

            while (
                    myGeneration
                            == generation.get()
                            && System.currentTimeMillis()
                            < deadline) {

                long head =
                        track.getPlaybackHeadPosition()
                                & 0xFFFFFFFFL;

                if (head >= totalFrames) {
                    break;
                }

                try {
                    Thread.sleep(20L);
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    Thread.currentThread()
                            .interrupt();
                    return;
                }
            }

            if (myGeneration
                    == generation.get()) {

                postFinished(
                        myGeneration,
                        listener
                );
            }

        } finally {

            if (currentTrack == track) {
                currentTrack = null;
            }

            try {
                track.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            try {
                track.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private static float speedForEmotion(
            String emotion) {

        if (emotion == null) {
            return 1.0f;
        }

        switch (emotion.toLowerCase()) {

            case "joy":
                return 1.04f;

            case "embarrassment":
                return 1.06f;

            case "pride":
                return 0.99f;

            case "serious":
                return 0.96f;

            case "disgust":
                return 0.98f;

            default:
                return 1.0f;
        }
    }

    static String sanitize(String s) {

        if (s == null) {
            return "";
        }

        s = s.replaceAll(
                "\\*[^*\\n]{0,80}\\*",
                " "
        );

        s = s.replace("*", "")
                .replace("`", "")
                .replace("#", "")
                .replace("_", " ");

        StringBuilder sb =
                new StringBuilder(
                        s.length()
                );

        for (int i = 0;
             i < s.length();) {

            int cp =
                    s.codePointAt(i);

            i += Character.charCount(cp);

            boolean emoji =
                    cp >= 0x1F000
                            || (cp >= 0x2600
                            && cp <= 0x27BF)
                            || cp == 0xFE0F
                            || cp == 0x200D;

            if (!emoji) {
                sb.appendCodePoint(cp);
            }
        }

        return sb.toString()
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    private void postStarted(
            final int generationId,
            final Listener listener) {

        main.post(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {

                if (generationId
                        == generation.get()
                        && listener != null) {

                    listener.onPlaybackStarted();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void postFinished(
            final int generationId,
            final Listener listener) {

        main.post(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {

                if (generationId
                        == generation.get()) {

                    busy = false;

                    if (listener != null) {
                        listener.onPlaybackFinished();
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void postError(
            final int generationId,
            final Listener listener,
            final String message) {

        main.post(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {

                if (generationId
                        == generation.get()) {

                    busy = false;

                    if (listener != null) {
                        listener.onError(message);
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private static void deleteRecursively(
            File file) {

        if (file == null
                || !file.exists()) {
            return;
        }

        if (file.isDirectory()) {

            File[] children =
                    file.listFiles();

            if (children != null) {

                for (File child : children) {
                    deleteRecursively(child);
                }
            }
        }

        //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        file.delete();
    }
}

package com.amadeus.companion.local;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

/** User configuration stored in SharedPreferences. No API key is ever hardcoded. */
public class AppSettings {

    public static final String DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL = "gemini-3.1-flash-lite";
    public static final String DEFAULT_TTS_MODEL = "Kokoro (offline)";
    public static final String DEFAULT_TTS_VOICE = "af_nicole";
    public static final int DEFAULT_TURNS = 8;
    public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_RECORD_SEC = 15;
    public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_REPLY_CHARS = 400;
    public static final int DEFAULT_FRAME_MS = 140;

    private static final String PREFS = "amadeus_settings";
    private static final String K_API_KEY = "api_key";
    private static final String K_CHAT_MODEL = "chat_model";
    private static final String K_TTS_MODEL = "tts_model";
    private static final String K_TTS_VOICE = "tts_voice";
    private static final String K_TURNS = "history_turns";
    private static final String K_MAX_RECORD = "max_record_sec";
    private static final String K_MAX_REPLY = "max_reply_chars";
    private static final String K_FRAME_MS = "frame_ms";

    private final SharedPreferences prefs;

    public AppSettings(Context context) {
        prefs = context.getApplicationContext().getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    public String getApiKey() { return prefs.getString(K_API_KEY, "").trim(); }
    public void setApiKey(String v) { prefs.edit().putString(K_API_KEY, v == null ? "" : v.trim()).apply(); }
    public boolean hasApiKey() { return getApiKey().length() > 0; }

    public String getChatModel() {
        String v = prefs.getString(K_CHAT_MODEL, DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL).trim();
        return v.isEmpty() ? DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL : v;
    }
    public void setChatModel(String v) { prefs.edit().putString(K_CHAT_MODEL, v == null ? "" : v.trim()).apply(); }

    public String getTtsModel() {
        String v = prefs.getString(K_TTS_MODEL, DEFAULT_TTS_MODEL).trim();
        return v.isEmpty() ? DEFAULT_TTS_MODEL : v;
    }
    public void setTtsModel(String v) { prefs.edit().putString(K_TTS_MODEL, v == null ? "" : v.trim()).apply(); }

    /** Empty string means "use the voice from assets/tts_prompt.txt". */
    public String getTtsVoice() { return prefs.getString(K_TTS_VOICE, "").trim(); }
    public void setTtsVoice(String v) { prefs.edit().putString(K_TTS_VOICE, v == null ? "" : v.trim()).apply(); }

    public int getHistoryTurns() { return clamp(prefs.getInt(K_TURNS, DEFAULT_TURNS), 0, 30); }
    public void setHistoryTurns(int v) { prefs.edit().putInt(K_TURNS, clamp(v, 0, 30)).apply(); }

    public int getMaxRecordSeconds() { return clamp(prefs.getInt(K_MAX_RECORD, DEFAULT_MAX_RECORD_SEC), 3, 60); }
    public void setMaxRecordSeconds(int v) { prefs.edit().putInt(K_MAX_RECORD, clamp(v, 3, 60)).apply(); }

    public int getMaxReplyChars() { return clamp(prefs.getInt(K_MAX_REPLY, DEFAULT_MAX_REPLY_CHARS), 60, 2000); }
    public void setMaxReplyChars(int v) { prefs.edit().putInt(K_MAX_REPLY, clamp(v, 60, 2000)).apply(); }

    /** Milliseconds per talking frame. Lower = faster mouth animation. */
    public int getFrameIntervalMs() { return clamp(prefs.getInt(K_FRAME_MS, DEFAULT_FRAME_MS), 60, 500); }
    public void setFrameIntervalMs(int v) { prefs.edit().putInt(K_FRAME_MS, clamp(v, 60, 500)).apply(); }

    private static int clamp(int v, int lo, int hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }
}

        File tokens =
                new File(
                        dir,
                        "tokens.txt"
                );

        File espeak =
                new File(
                        dir,
                        "espeak-ng-data"
                );

        if (model.isFile()
                && tokens.isFile()
                && espeak.isDirectory()) {
            return;
        }

        deleteRecursively(dir);

        if (!dir.mkdirs()
                && !dir.isDirectory()) {
            throw new IOException(
                    "Cannot create Piper model directory"
            );
        }

        copyAssetTree(
                context.getAssets(),
                ASSET_ROOT,
                dir
        );
    }

    private static void copyAssetTree(
            AssetManager assets,
            String assetPath,
            File out)
            throws IOException {

        String[] children =
                assets.list(assetPath);

        if (children != null
                && children.length > 0) {

            if (!out.exists()
                    && !out.mkdirs()) {
                throw new IOException(
                        "Cannot create directory: "
                                + out
                );
            }

            for (String child : children) {
                copyAssetTree(
                        assets,
                        assetPath + "/" + child,
                        new File(out, child)
                );
            }

            return;
        }

        File parent =
                out.getParentFile();

        if (parent != null
                && !parent.exists()
                && !parent.mkdirs()) {
            throw new IOException(
                    "Cannot create directory: "
                            + parent
            );
        }

        InputStream input =
                assets.open(
                        assetPath,
                        AssetManager.ACCESS_STREAMING
                );

        FileOutputStream output =
                new FileOutputStream(out);

        try {
            byte[] buffer =
                    new byte[64 * 1024];

            int count;

            while ((count =
                    input.read(buffer)) != -1) {

                output.write(
                        buffer,
                        0,
                        count
                );
            }

        } finally {

            try {
                input.close();
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }

            try {
                output.close();
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private void play(
            GeneratedAudio audio,
            int myGeneration,
            Listener listener)
            throws IOException {

        float[] samples =
                audio.getSamples();

        int sampleRate =
                audio.getSampleRate();

        if (samples == null
                || samples.length == 0
                || sampleRate <= 0) {

            throw new IOException(
                    "empty generated audio"
            );
        }

        short[] pcm =
                new short[samples.length];

        for (int i = 0;
             i < samples.length;
             i++) {

            float x = samples[i];

            if (x > 1.0f) {
                x = 1.0f;
            } else if (x < -1.0f) {
                x = -1.0f;
            }

            pcm[i] =
                    (short) Math.round(
                            x * 32767.0f
                    );
        }

        int channelMask =
                AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO;

        int minBuffer =
                AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                        sampleRate,
                        channelMask,
                        AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
                );

        if (minBuffer <= 0) {
            throw new IOException(
                    "audio output unavailable"
            );
        }

        int bufferSize =
                Math.max(
                        minBuffer * 2,
                        sampleRate * 2 / 5
                );

        AudioTrack track =
                new AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(
                                new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                        .setUsage(
                                                AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA
                                        )
                                        .setContentType(
                                                AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH
                                        )
                                        .build()
                        )
                        .setAudioFormat(
                                new AudioFormat.Builder()
                                        .setEncoding(
                                                AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
                                        )
                                        .setSampleRate(
                                                sampleRate
                                        )
                                        .setChannelMask(
                                                channelMask
                                        )
                                        .build()
                        )
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(
                                bufferSize
                        )
                        .setTransferMode(
                                AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM
                        )
                        .build();

        if (track.getState()
                != AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {

            track.release();

            throw new IOException(
                    "audio output not initialized"
            );
        }

        currentTrack = track;

        try {

            if (myGeneration
                    != generation.get()) {
                return;
            }

            track.play();

            postStarted(
                    myGeneration,
                    listener
            );

            int offset = 0;

            while (offset < pcm.length
                    && myGeneration
                    == generation.get()) {

                int count =
                        Math.min(
                                2048,
                                pcm.length - offset
                        );

                int written =
                        track.write(
                                pcm,
                                offset,
                                count
                        );

                if (written < 0) {
                    throw new IOException(
                            "AudioTrack.write failed: "
                                    + written
                    );
                }

                offset += written;
            }

            if (myGeneration
                    != generation.get()) {
                return;
            }

            long totalFrames =
                    pcm.length;

            long deadline =
                    System.currentTimeMillis()
                            + ((totalFrames
                            * 1000L)
                            / sampleRate)
                            + 2000L;

            while (
                    myGeneration
                            == generation.get()
                            && System.currentTimeMillis()
                            < deadline) {

                long head =
                        track.getPlaybackHeadPosition()
                                & 0xFFFFFFFFL;

                if (head >= totalFrames) {
                    break;
                }

                try {
                    Thread.sleep(20L);
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    Thread.currentThread()
                            .interrupt();
                    return;
                }
            }

            if (myGeneration
                    == generation.get()) {

                postFinished(
                        myGeneration,
                        listener
                );
            }

        } finally {

            if (currentTrack == track) {
                currentTrack = null;
            }

            try {
                track.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            try {
                track.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private static float speedForEmotion(
            String emotion) {

        if (emotion == null) {
            return 1.0f;
        }

        switch (emotion.toLowerCase()) {

            case "joy":
                return 1.04f;

            case "embarrassment":
                return 1.06f;

            case "pride":
                return 0.99f;

            case "serious":
                return 0.96f;

            case "disgust":
                return 0.98f;

            default:
                return 1.0f;
        }
    }

    static String sanitize(String s) {

        if (s == null) {
            return "";
        }

        s = s.replaceAll(
                "\\*[^*\\n]{0,80}\\*",
                " "
        );

        s = s.replace("*", "")
                .replace("`", "")
                .replace("#", "")
                .replace("_", " ");

        StringBuilder sb =
                new StringBuilder(
                        s.length()
                );

        for (int i = 0;
             i < s.length();) {

            int cp =
                    s.codePointAt(i);

            i += Character.charCount(cp);

            boolean emoji =
                    cp >= 0x1F000
                            || (cp >= 0x2600
                            && cp <= 0x27BF)
                            || cp == 0xFE0F
                            || cp == 0x200D;

            if (!emoji) {
                sb.appendCodePoint(cp);
            }
        }

        return sb.toString()
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    private void postStarted(
            final int generationId,
            final Listener listener) {

        main.post(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {

                if (generationId
                        == generation.get()
                        && listener != null) {

                    listener.onPlaybackStarted();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void postFinished(
            final int generationId,
            final Listener listener) {

        main.post(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {

                if (generationId
                        == generation.get()) {

                    busy = false;

                    if (listener != null) {
                        listener.onPlaybackFinished();
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void postError(
            final int generationId,
            final Listener listener,
            final String message) {

        main.post(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {

                if (generationId
                        == generation.get()) {

                    busy = false;

                    if (listener != null) {
                        listener.onError(message);
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private static void deleteRecursively(
            File file) {

        if (file == null
                || !file.exists()) {
            return;
        }

        if (file.isDirectory()) {

            File[] children =
                    file.listFiles();

            if (children != null) {

                for (File child : children) {
                    deleteRecursively(child);
                }
            }
        }

        //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        file.delete();
    }
}

package com.amadeus.companion.local;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

/** User configuration stored in SharedPreferences. No API key is ever hardcoded. */
public class AppSettings {

    public static final String DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL = "gemini-3.1-flash-lite";
    public static final String DEFAULT_TTS_MODEL = "Kokoro (offline)";
    public static final String DEFAULT_TTS_VOICE = "af_nicole";
    public static final int DEFAULT_TURNS = 8;
    public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_RECORD_SEC = 15;
    public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_REPLY_CHARS = 400;
    public static final int DEFAULT_FRAME_MS = 140;

    private static final String PREFS = "amadeus_settings";
    private static final String K_API_KEY = "api_key";
    private static final String K_CHAT_MODEL = "chat_model";
    private static final String K_TTS_MODEL = "tts_model";
    private static final String K_TTS_VOICE = "tts_voice";
    private static final String K_TURNS = "history_turns";
    private static final String K_MAX_RECORD = "max_record_sec";
    private static final String K_MAX_REPLY = "max_reply_chars";
    private static final String K_FRAME_MS = "frame_ms";

    private final SharedPreferences prefs;

    public AppSettings(Context context) {
        prefs = context.getApplicationContext().getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }

    public String getApiKey() { return prefs.getString(K_API_KEY, "").trim(); }
    public void setApiKey(String v) { prefs.edit().putString(K_API_KEY, v == null ? "" : v.trim()).apply(); }
    public boolean hasApiKey() { return getApiKey().length() > 0; }

    public String getChatModel() {
        String v = prefs.getString(K_CHAT_MODEL, DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL).trim();
        return v.isEmpty() ? DEFAULT_CHAT_MODEL : v;
    }
    public void setChatModel(String v) { prefs.edit().putString(K_CHAT_MODEL, v == null ? "" : v.trim()).apply(); }

    public String getTtsModel() {
        String v = prefs.getString(K_TTS_MODEL, DEFAULT_TTS_MODEL).trim();
        return v.isEmpty() ? DEFAULT_TTS_MODEL : v;
    }
    public void setTtsModel(String v) { prefs.edit().putString(K_TTS_MODEL, v == null ? "" : v.trim()).apply(); }

    /** Empty string means "use the voice from assets/tts_prompt.txt". */
    public String getTtsVoice() { return prefs.getString(K_TTS_VOICE, "").trim(); }
    public void setTtsVoice(String v) { prefs.edit().putString(K_TTS_VOICE, v == null ? "" : v.trim()).apply(); }

    public int getHistoryTurns() { return clamp(prefs.getInt(K_TURNS, DEFAULT_TURNS), 0, 30); }
    public void setHistoryTurns(int v) { prefs.edit().putInt(K_TURNS, clamp(v, 0, 30)).apply(); }

    public int getMaxRecordSeconds() { return clamp(prefs.getInt(K_MAX_RECORD, DEFAULT_MAX_RECORD_SEC), 3, 60); }
    public void setMaxRecordSeconds(int v) { prefs.edit().putInt(K_MAX_RECORD, clamp(v, 3, 60)).apply(); }

    public int getMaxReplyChars() { return clamp(prefs.getInt(K_MAX_REPLY, DEFAULT_MAX_REPLY_CHARS), 60, 2000); }
    public void setMaxReplyChars(int v) { prefs.edit().putInt(K_MAX_REPLY, clamp(v, 60, 2000)).apply(); }

    /** Milliseconds per talking frame. Lower = faster mouth animation. */
    public int getFrameIntervalMs() { return clamp(prefs.getInt(K_FRAME_MS, DEFAULT_FRAME_MS), 60, 500); }
    public void setFrameIntervalMs(int v) { prefs.edit().putInt(K_FRAME_MS, clamp(v, 60, 500)).apply(); }

    private static int clamp(int v, int lo, int hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }
}

package com.amadeus.companion.local;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.AssetManager;
import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioTrack;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.util.Log;

import com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.GeneratedAudio;
import com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTts;
import com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsConfig;
import com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsModelConfig;
import com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsVitsModelConfig;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public final class TtsManager {

    public interface Listener {
        void onPlaybackStarted();
        void onPlaybackFinished();
        void onError(String message);
    }

    private static final String TAG = "AmadeusPiperTTS";

    private static final String ASSET_ROOT =
            "vits-piper-en_US-amy-low-int8";

    private static final String MODEL_DIR_NAME =
            "vits-piper-en_US-amy-low-int8";

    private static final int NUM_THREADS = 2;

    // Piper en_US-amy-low is single-speaker.
    private static final int SPEAKER_ID = 0;

    private final Context context;
    private final Handler main =
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    private final ExecutorService executor =
            Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private final AtomicInteger generation =
            new AtomicInteger(0);

    private volatile Future<?> currentJob;
    private volatile OfflineTts tts;
    private volatile AudioTrack currentTrack;
    private volatile boolean busy;

    public TtsManager(Context context,
                      AppSettings ignoredSettings) {
        this.context =
                context.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public boolean isBusy() {
        return busy;
    }

    /**
     * Loads Piper in the background so the first spoken reply
     * does not have to initialize the engine.
     */
    public void preload() {
        executor.execute(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {
                try {
                    long start =
                            SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                    ensureEngine();

                    Log.i(TAG,
                            "Piper engine ready in "
                                    + (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                    - start)
                                    + " ms");
                } catch (Throwable e) {
                    Log.e(TAG,
                            "Piper preload failed",
                            e);
                }
            }
        });
    }

    public synchronized void stop() {
        generation.incrementAndGet();

        Future<?> job = currentJob;
        currentJob = null;

        if (job != null) {
            job.cancel(true);
        }

        AudioTrack track = currentTrack;

        if (track != null) {
            try {
                track.pause();
                track.flush();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }

        busy = false;
    }

    public synchronized void speak(
            final String replyText,
            final String emotionKey,
            final Listener listener) {

        stop();

        final int myGeneration =
                generation.get();

        final String text =
                sanitize(replyText);

        if (text.isEmpty()) {
            postFinished(
                    myGeneration,
                    listener
            );
            return;
        }

        busy = true;

        currentJob =
                executor.submit(new Runnable() {
                    @Override
                    public void run() {

                        try {
                            long totalStart =
                                    SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                            Log.i(
                                    TAG,
                                    "TTS request started"
                            );

                            OfflineTts engine =
                                    ensureEngine();

                            if (myGeneration
                                    != generation.get()) {
                                return;
                            }

                            float speed =
                                    speedForEmotion(
                                            emotionKey);

                            long genStart =
                                    SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();

                            GeneratedAudio audio =
                                    engine.generate(
                                            text,
                                            SPEAKER_ID,
                                            speed
                                    );

                            long genMs =
                                    SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                            - genStart;

                            Log.i(
                                    TAG,
                                    "Piper generation took "
                                            + genMs
                                            + " ms for "
                                            + text.length()
                                            + " chars"
                            );

                            if (myGeneration
                                    != generation.get()) {
                                return;
                            }

                            play(
                                    audio,
                                    myGeneration,
                                    listener
                            );

                            Log.i(
                                    TAG,
                                    "Total TTS time: "
                                            + (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                            - totalStart)
                                            + " ms"
                            );

                        } catch (Throwable e) {

                            Log.e(
                                    TAG,
                                    "Piper TTS failed",
                                    e
                            );

                            postError(
                                    myGeneration,
                                    listener,
                                    "Local voice unavailable."
                            );

                        } finally {

                            if (myGeneration
                                    == generation.get()) {
                                busy = false;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });
    }

    public synchronized void release() {
        stop();

        executor.shutdownNow();

        OfflineTts engine = tts;
        tts = null;

        if (engine != null) {
            try {
                engine.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private OfflineTts ensureEngine()
            throws IOException {

        OfflineTts existing = tts;

        if (existing != null) {
            return existing;
        }

        synchronized (this) {

            if (tts != null) {
                return tts;
            }

            File dir =
                    new File(
                            context.getFilesDir(),
                            MODEL_DIR_NAME
                    );

            prepareModelFiles(dir);

            String model =
                    new File(
                            dir,
                            "en_US-amy-low.onnx"
                    ).getAbsolutePath();

            String tokens =
                    new File(
                            dir,
                            "tokens.txt"
                    ).getAbsolutePath();

            String dataDir =
                    new File(
                            dir,
                            "espeak-ng-data"
                    ).getAbsolutePath();

            OfflineTtsVitsModelConfig vits =
                    new OfflineTtsVitsModelConfig();

            vits.setModel(model);
            vits.setLexicon("");
            vits.setTokens(tokens);
            vits.setDataDir(dataDir);
            vits.setDictDir("");
            vits.setNoiseScale(0.667f);
            vits.setNoiseScaleW(0.8f);
            vits.setLengthScale(1.0f);

            OfflineTtsModelConfig modelConfig =
                    new OfflineTtsModelConfig();

            modelConfig.setVits(vits);
            modelConfig.setNumThreads(NUM_THREADS);
            modelConfig.setDebug(false);
            modelConfig.setProvider("cpu");

            OfflineTtsConfig config =
                    new OfflineTtsConfig();

            config.setModel(modelConfig);
            config.setRuleFsts("");
            config.setRuleFars("");
            config.setMaxNumSentences(1);
            config.setSilenceScale(0.2f);

            // Paths above point to normal filesystem files.
            tts = new OfflineTts(null, config);

            return tts;
        }
    }

    private void prepareModelFiles(File dir)
            throws IOException {

        File model =
                new File(
                        dir,
                        "en_US-amy-low.onnx"
                );

        File tokens =
                new File(
                        dir,
                        "tokens.txt"
                );

        File espeak =
                new File(
                        dir,
                        "espeak-ng-data"
                );

        if (model.isFile()
                && tokens.isFile()
                && espeak.isDirectory()) {
            return;
        }

        deleteRecursively(dir);

        if (!dir.mkdirs()
                && !dir.isDirectory()) {
            throw new IOException(
                    "Cannot create Piper model directory"
            );
        }

        copyAssetTree(
                context.getAssets(),
                ASSET_ROOT,
                dir
        );
    }

    private static void copyAssetTree(
            AssetManager assets,
            String assetPath,
            File out)
            throws IOException {

        String[] children =
                assets.list(assetPath);

        if (children != null
                && children.length > 0) {

            if (!out.exists()
                    && !out.mkdirs()) {
                throw new IOException(
                        "Cannot create directory: "
                                + out
                );
            }

            for (String child : children) {
                copyAssetTree(
                        assets,
                        assetPath + "/" + child,
                        new File(out, child)
                );
            }

            return;
        }

        File parent =
                out.getParentFile();

        if (parent != null
                && !parent.exists()
                && !parent.mkdirs()) {
            throw new IOException(
                    "Cannot create directory: "
                            + parent
            );
        }

        InputStream input =
                assets.open(
                        assetPath,
                        AssetManager.ACCESS_STREAMING
                );

        FileOutputStream output =
                new FileOutputStream(out);

        try {
            byte[] buffer =
                    new byte[64 * 1024];

            int count;

            while ((count =
                    input.read(buffer)) != -1) {

                output.write(
                        buffer,
                        0,
                        count
                );
            }

        } finally {

            try {
                input.close();
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }

            try {
                output.close();
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private void play(

                    "empty generated audio"
            );
        }

                new short[samples.length];

             i < samples.length;

                x = 1.0f;
            } else if (x < -1.0f) {
                x = -1.0f;
            }

            pcm[i] =
                    (short) Math.round(
                            x * 32767.0f
                    );
        }

                AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO;

                AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                        sampleRate,
                        channelMask,
                        AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
                );

        if (minBuffer <= 0) {
            throw new IOException(
                    "audio output unavailable"
            );
        }

        int bufferSize =
                Math.max(
                        minBuffer * 2,
                        sampleRate * 2 / 5
                );

        AudioTrack track =
                new AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(
                                new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                        .setUsage(
                                                AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA
                                        )
                                        .setContentType(
                                                AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH
                                        )
                                        .build()
                        )
                        .setAudioFormat(
                                new AudioFormat.Builder()
                                        .setEncoding(
                                                AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
                                        )
                                        .setSampleRate(
                                                sampleRate
                                        )
                                        .setChannelMask(
                                                channelMask
                                        )
                                        .build()
                        )
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(
                                bufferSize
                        )
                        .setTransferMode(
                                AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM
                        )
                        .build();

        if (track.getState()
                != AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {

            track.release();

            throw new IOException(

        }

            }

                        Math.min(
                                2048,
                                pcm.length - offset
                        );

                int written =
                        track.write(
                                pcm,
                                offset,
                                count
                        );

                if (written < 0) {
                    throw new IOException(
                            "AudioTrack.write failed: "
                                    + written
                    );
                }

                offset += written;
            }

            if (myGeneration
                    != generation.get()) {
                return;
            }

            long totalFrames =
                    pcm.length;

            long deadline =
                    System.currentTimeMillis()
                            + ((totalFrames
                            * 1000L)
                            / sampleRate)
                            + 2000L;

            while (
                    myGeneration
                            == generation.get()
                            && System.currentTimeMillis()
                            < deadline) {

                long head =
                        track.getPlaybackHeadPosition()
                                & 0xFFFFFFFFL;

                if (head >= totalFrames) {
                    break;
                }

                try {
                    Thread.sleep(20L);
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    Thread.currentThread()
                            .interrupt();
                    return;
                }
            }

            if (myGeneration
                    == generation.get()) {

                postFinished(
                        myGeneration,
                        listener
                );
            }

        } finally {

            if (currentTrack == track) {
                currentTrack = null;
            }

            try {
                track.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            try {
                track.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private static float speedForEmotion(
            String emotion) {

        if (emotion == null) {
            return 1.0f;
        }

        switch (emotion.toLowerCase()) {

            case "joy":
                return 1.04f;

            case "embarrassment":
                return 1.06f;

            case "pride":
                return 0.99f;

            case "serious":
                return 0.96f;

            case "disgust":
                return 0.98f;

            default:
                return 1.0f;
        }
    }

    static String sanitize(String s) {

        if (s == null) {
            return "";
        }

        s = s.replaceAll(
                "\\*[^*\\n]{0,80}\\*",
                " "
        );

        s = s.replace("*", "")
                .replace("`", "")
                .replace("#", "")
                .replace("_", " ");

        StringBuilder sb =
                new StringBuilder(
                        s.length()
                );

        for (int i = 0;
             i < s.length();) {

            int cp =
                    s.codePointAt(i);

            i += Character.charCount(cp);

            boolean emoji =
                    cp >= 0x1F000
                            || (cp >= 0x2600
                            && cp <= 0x27BF)
                            || cp == 0xFE0F
                            || cp == 0x200D;

            if (!emoji) {
                sb.appendCodePoint(cp);
            }
        }

        return sb.toString()
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
    }

    private void postStarted(
            final int generationId,
            final Listener listener) {

        main.post(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {

                if (generationId
                        == generation.get()
                        && listener != null) {

                    listener.onPlaybackStarted();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void postFinished(
            final int generationId,
            final Listener listener) {

        main.post(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {

                if (generationId
                        == generation.get()) {

                    busy = false;

                    if (listener != null) {
                        listener.onPlaybackFinished();
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void postError(
            final int generationId,
            final Listener listener,
            final String message) {

        main.post(new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {

                if (generationId
                        == generation.get()) {

                    busy = false;

                    if (listener != null) {
                        listener.onError(message);
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private static void deleteRecursively(
            File file) {

        if (file == null
                || !file.exists()) {
            return;
        }

        if (file.isDirectory()) {

            File[] children =
                    file.listFiles();

            if (children != null) {

                for (File child : children) {
                    deleteRecursively(child);
                }
            }
        }

        //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        file.delete();
    }
}

    }

    public static native void init();
    public static native void release();
    public static native int getSampleRate();
    public static native short[] synthesize(
        String text,
        float durationStretch,
        float pitchMean,

package com.amadeus.companion.local;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioTrack;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;

import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public final class TtsManager {
    public interface Listener {
        void onPlaybackStarted();
        void onPlaybackFinished();
        void onError(String message);
    }

    private static final String TAG = "TtsManager";
    private final Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(r -> {
        Thread t = new Thread(r, "flite-tts");
        t.setPriority(Thread.NORM_PRIORITY);
        return t;
    });
    private final AtomicInteger generation = new AtomicInteger();

    private volatile Future<?> currentTask;
    private volatile AudioTrack track;
    private volatile boolean released;

    public TtsManager(Context context, AppSettings settings) {
        try {
            FliteNative.init();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Flite init failed", t);
        }
    }

    public void preload() {
        if (released) return;
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                FliteNative.init();
                Log.d(TAG, "Flite ready, sampleRate=" + FliteNative.getSampleRate());
            } catch (Throwable t) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Flite preload failed", t);
            }
        });
    }

    public void speak(String text, String emotionKey, Listener listener) {
        if (released || text == null || text.trim().isEmpty()) return;

        final int token = generation.incrementAndGet();
        stopCurrentAudio();

        Future<?> old = currentTask;
        if (old != null) old.cancel(true);

        currentTask = executor.submit(() -> {
            try {
                long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
                FliteNative.init();

                float[] prosody = prosodyForEmotion(emotionKey);

                short[] pcm = FliteNative.synthesize(
                        text,
                        prosody[0],
                        prosody[1],
                        prosody[2]);

                long synthMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - start;
                Log.d(TAG, "Flite generation took " + synthMs + " ms ("
                        + text.length() + " chars)");

                if (pcm == null || pcm.length == 0 || token != generation.get()) return;

                int sampleRate = FliteNative.getSampleRate();
                int bufferSize = pcm.length * 2;
                if (bufferSize <= 0) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid PCM buffer size");
                }

                AudioTrack local = new AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setAudioFormat(new AudioFormat.Builder()
                                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                                .setSampleRate(sampleRate)
                                .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                                .build())
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(bufferSize)
                        .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STATIC)
                        .build();
                track = local;

                if (token != generation.get()) {
                    local.release();
                    return;
                }

                int written = local.write(pcm, 0, pcm.length);
                Log.d(TAG, "Flite AudioTrack write=" + written + " / " + pcm.length
                        + ", sampleRate=" + sampleRate
                        + ", trackState=" + local.getState());

                if (written != pcm.length) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "AudioTrack wrote " + written + " of " + pcm.length + " samples");
                }

                local.play();

                main.post(() -> {
                    if (token == generation.get()) {
                        listener.onPlaybackStarted();
                    }
                });

                while (token == generation.get()
                        && local.getPlaybackHeadPosition() < pcm.length) {
                    Thread.sleep(10);
                }

                try { local.stop(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                local.release();
                if (track == local) track = null;

                if (token == generation.get()) {
                    main.post(() -> {
                        if (token == generation.get()) {
                            listener.onPlaybackFinished();
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            } catch (Throwable t) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Flite TTS failed", t);
                if (token == generation.get()) {
                    String message = t.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + t.getMessage();
                    main.post(() -> {
                        if (token == generation.get()) {
                            listener.onError(message);
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        });
    }

    public boolean isBusy() {
        Future<?> task = currentTask;
        return (task != null && !task.isDone()) || track != null;
    }

    private static float[] prosodyForEmotion(String emotion) {
        // A/B test cực đoan:
        // normal = A: rất thấp + phẳng
        // joy    = B: rất cao + nhiều biến thiên
        if ("joy".equals(emotion)) {
            return new float[]{1.00f, 220.0f, 30.0f};
        }
        return new float[]{1.00f, 120.0f, 4.0f};
    }

    public void stop() {
        generation.incrementAndGet();
        Future<?> task = currentTask;
        if (task != null) task.cancel(true);
        stopCurrentAudio();
    }

    private void stopCurrentAudio() {
        AudioTrack local = track;
        track = null;
        if (local == null) return;
        try { local.stop(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        try { local.flush(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        try { local.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    public void release() {
        if (released) return;
        released = true;
        generation.incrementAndGet();
        Future<?> task = currentTask;
        if (task != null) task.cancel(true);
        stopCurrentAudio();
        executor.shutdownNow();
        try { FliteNative.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private static float durationStretchForEmotion(String emotion) {
        if (emotion == null) return 1.00f;
        switch (emotion) {
            case "joy": return 0.94f;
            case "embarrassment": return 0.92f;
            case "pride": return 0.98f;
            case "serious": return 1.06f;
            case "disgust": return 1.03f;
            default: return 1.00f;
        }
    }
}

/**

 * Voice flow (one Gemini conversation request + one local Kokoro TTS synthesis per turn):
 *   mic down -> AudioRecorder.start -> mic up -> AudioRecorder.stop -> SpriteManager.setThinking
 *   -> GeminiClient.sendAudio (Gemini understands the speech itself) -> JSON reply
 *   -> ConversationManager.update -> MemoryManager.update -> SpriteManager.setExpression
 *   -> TtsManager.speak (local Kokoro) -> (playback starts) SpriteManager.setTalking -> (ends) SpriteManager.setIdle
 * Android speech recognition is not used anywhere.

public class MainActivity extends Activity {

    private final List<CharSequence> lines = new ArrayList<>();
